sources.entry: AFFiNE | Knowledge base that combines docs, whiteboards and databases

summary.one_liner: AFFiNE is an open-source, local-first workspace that combines docs, whiteboard canvas, and databases, positioned as an alternative to Notion and Miro.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes AFFiNE as an all-in-one knowledge base and workspace for wikis, knowledge management, presentations, and digital assets. Its edgeless canvas can hold rich text, sticky notes, embedded web pages, multi-view databases, linked pages, shapes, and slides. It offers an AI assistant that can turn outlines into slides, summarize articles into mind maps, and generate prototypes from prompts. It supports local-first data ownership with real-time sync and collaboration across web and cross-platform clients. Users can self-host it with Docker, and the README says the Community Edition is free under the MIT license.
use_cases: Build a personal or team knowledge base and wiki
Combine notes, whiteboards, and databases in one workspace
Create presentations and slides from outlines
Self-host a Notion or Miro alternative
Collaborate in real time on documents and canvases
how_to_run: Self-host with Docker (see the project documentation for details)
Or open a GitHub Codespace from the repo's Code button (creates a codespace on master)
notable: Docs, whiteboard, and databases merged on one edgeless canvas
Local-first data ownership with real-time collaboration
Built-in multimodal AI for mind maps, slides, and prototypes
Built on its own open-source editor (BlockSuite) and database (OctoBase / y-octo)
caveats: Enterprise Edition is not yet published; it will add features such as SSO and audit
Plugin community and third-party blocks are described as coming soon
Self-hosting details are in external documentation, not the README itself
summary.license: MIT (Community Edition, per the README; see LICENSE)
